bottleneck.summary: The Hf-for-Lu frozen contrast is favorable throughout all ten integration tokens and has an independent Tc gain. Other frozen routes are not all favorable: ZrRe2 and ZrTc4Hf outperform target, while Y→Hf lambda crosses sign. Keep this local role hypothesis, not an elemental ranking. Heavy Re/SOC, ordered-vs-disordered phase and C14/C15 competition remain model limitations.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 1.2914516857388574e-05 eV/Å, pressure 0.0 GPa; fine force 0.00599099983732581 eV/Å, pressure 0.002 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Lu-to-Hf ordered C15-related site construction. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Use saved Re-site modes and occupation/orbital data for Lu/Hf neighbors. Favorable: the role-specific gain survives matched screening and local phase checks; adverse: C14/decomposition or SOC changes the favorable branch; ambiguous: no mode/source-state association.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
